title: Top score and top results in 2020, with four goals Exceeds
summary: My 2020 review, for the year I ran the bar-raiser program, the remote connect program and quality at desk, rated four goals Exceeds. My manager called it the top score and top results of the year.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a review, not an intervention.
what_i_did: Ran the bar-raiser hiring program, the remote connect program and the quality-at-desk program.
what_changed: Four goals Exceeds and three Meets; my manager asked me to raise the bar again the next year.

quotes.text: Congratulations on the top score and top results this year! Let's raise the bar again further next year.
